water_jar.name: Clay water jar
water_jar.description: A chipped but whole clay jar for carrying water. It belongs to Miriam.

lepton.name: Copper lepton
lepton.description: The smallest coin in common use. Two of them are scarcely a loaf's worth of bread.

ezra_sword.name: Ezra's Sword
ezra_sword.description: A plain, well-kept sword with a worn grip. Elder Ezra carried it on the roads when he was young, and gave it to you for the road to the Jordan. He told you to keep it sheathed unless you must.

rope_belt.name: Rope belt
rope_belt.description: A length of knotted rope that keeps a tunic from flapping. Everyone in the village owns one.

leather_belt.name: Leather belt
leather_belt.description: A stiff leather belt with a bronze buckle. It holds a tunic snugly and does not fray.

plain_tunic.name: Plain tunic
plain_tunic.description: Undyed wool, patched at the elbow. It keeps off the sun and very little else.

quilted_vest.name: Quilted vest
quilted_vest.description: Layers of linen stitched together and stuffed with wool. Warm, and a little hard to run in.

worn_sandals.name: Worn sandals
worn_sandals.description: Leather soles and cord ties, shaped by your own feet over many seasons.

road_boots.name: Road boots
road_boots.description: Sturdy boots with hobnailed soles, made for a long walk on a bad road.

wicker_shield.name: Wicker shield
wicker_shield.description: A round shield of woven reeds over a wooden frame. Light, and good against a blow from the front.

felt_cap.name: Felt cap
felt_cap.description: A thick felt cap that takes some of the sting out of a knock on the head.

scroll_malachi.name: Scroll of Malachi
scroll_malachi.description: A worn scroll in a cracked leather case, written in Hebrew. You cannot read it well enough to follow it. Elder Ezra could.

scroll_kings.name: Scroll of the Kings
scroll_kings.description: A short scroll, dark with age and handling, in an old Hebrew hand. Someone must have prized it once. You cannot read it well enough to follow it.

fig_cake.name: Fig cake
fig_cake.description: Pressed dried figs, sweet and dense. Eating one takes the edge off a hard day.

flatbread.name: Flatbread
flatbread.description: A round of plain barley bread, still good.
